requiredSheets.title: _TechniqueBlocks
requiredSheets.purpose: Shared source-ordered technique keys (A), specific weapon owners or blank (B), rendered blocks (C), and a direct canonical techniqueKey/prerequisites import (F:G). It is a helper, not a Display/Formatted pair.

values.Function_Tests!A29: Full technique blocks embedded in weapon cards
values.Function_Tests!A31: Compact Spirit Blast and Spacium Ray references
values.Function_Tests!A33: Canonical rank notes remain in complete blocks
values.README!B17: The shared _TechniqueBlocks pool renders every canonical technique. The main alphabetical catalogue excludes base-specific weapon actions; weapon bases embed their full blocks. Unknown mechanics remain explicit. D/F/H/J/L/N are key-based excerpts.
values.README!B18: Use Format Sheet > Update all Display → Formatted tabs to refresh all seven pairs while preserving output tab IDs. Then update linked tables in the Handbook. Expand a linked range when new rows exceed its current range.
values.README!B19: Follow Spirit Blast and Spacium Ray: write starting damage plus a per-rank increase in damage (for example, 5 + Hits; +3 damage per weapon rank above 1.). Leave damageByRank blank for linear progressions; keep explicit maps only for irregular values.
values.README!B20: Keep pumpDamageByRank as canonical data. The shared renderer prints one Pump line, grouping only consecutive ranks with the same rate and unit. State the rank basis; keep distinct higher-rank effects and meaningful restrictions in rankNotes without repeating damage, pumping, weapon availability, or the zero-Energy base cost.
